about_the_game:
Heist Haven is a 1 to 4-player co-op online shooter set in the open-world criminal paradise of Haven. Assemble your crew, select your gear and customise your character: the next big score is waiting!

  • FPS Heists & Missions: Team up with friends or go solo to plan and execute high-stakes heists—complete Jobs and Missions for your criminal contacts to work your way up on the criminal ladder.

  • Co-op Gameplay: Play Solo or Team up with a crew of up to 4 Robbers online.

  • Vast Open World: Heists take place in locations inside the open world, which is explorable at your leisure and filled with secrets and surprises. Heists are only finished when the loot is delivered to a drop-off point and you have returned to your hideout.

  • Level up your Character & Crew: Create, customise and level up your Character. Progress through the world and unlock new equipment and vehicles by levelling up your Crew.

  • Customizable Weapons: Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons, gadgets, and vehicles tailored to your playstyle. Upgrade your gear and develop unique strategies to outsmart your foes.

  • Defeat Varied Enemies: From your average cop to tactical SWAT teams, experienced army units and even Helicopters and Jet Fighters, Heist Haven is filled with plenty of adversaries to test your capabilities.

content_descriptors.notes: Heist Haven features violence and frequent displays of criminal acts. There is no blood in the game.

detailed_description:
Demo Available

Get ready for a taster version of Heist Haven! Check out the Industrial District, try out 2 full Heists and level up your character and crew to Rank 2!

1 to 4 players online

The demo is playable in single-player and with up to 4 players online. Just invite your friends by opening the Steam Overlay, or let them join you. Want to join someone else? Check out the Session Browser in the main menu. Sessions which have been set to "Open" can be joined here. You can set your "Session Privacy" in the Settings screen under "Gameplay".

Progression to the full game

All progress you make in the game now will carry over to the full game. You can level your crew and character up to level 2. In the full game, you will be able to progress further. Any cash you stash, weapons you acquire and vehicles you steal will be waiting for you in the full game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DLSS support requires a supporting NVIDIA card.
